## Textbook practice {#practice}

CambridgeMATHS NSW Year 10, Stage 5 Core & Advanced/Extension Paths, third edition (2024). **Exercise 3D.**

| Time | Core practice |
|:--|:--|
| 5 min | pp. 200–201. Q2(a, c), Q3(a, c). Convert between root and index form. |
| 7 min | p. 201. Q4(a, d), Q5(a, c, f). Evaluate without a calculator. |
| 10 min | p. 201. Q6(a, c), Q7(j, k). Simplify products, quotients and powers. |
| 13 min | p. 202. Q8(a, b). Choose a method and use it with whole-number and fractional bases. |
| 5 min | Check your answers on p. 889. Identify a root, power or reciprocal error and redo that part. If all are correct, check Q5(f) a second way. |
